result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there is a spelling error in the search placeholder and an inconsistently styled favorite button on the second 'Popular right now' card. A card thumbnail also uses a mismatched light background versus the other carousel images.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second Popular card (pizza) uses a dark/filled circular background with a white outline heart, while the equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circle with a dark heart. The dark variant has poor contrast against the dark food photo and looks like a styling bug/mismatch.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button style (e.g., white circle with dark heart plus a subtle shadow) across all restaurant cards, ensuring adequate contrast over imagery.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light gray background while the neighbouring thumbnails have dark backgrounds, breaking visual rhythm and making the white duration pill hard to read on the light tile.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail backgrounds (or add a gradient overlay behind the duration pill) so all carousel images and their badges render consistently.
